title: Gaussian Ornstein–Uhlenbeck differential
statement: For a natural number $n$, a function $f:\mathbb{R}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, and a point $x\in\mathbb{R}^n$, define its Gaussian Ornstein–Uhlenbeck differential at $x$ by $Df(x)[x]-\sum_{i=1}^n D\bigl(y\mapsto Df(y)[e_i]\bigr)(x)[e_i]$, where $e_i$ is the $i$th coordinate vector and derivatives are understood as Fréchet derivatives.
